prep.auto.desc: On: after returning, the hero rests a few seconds in town and sets out again alone, with these settings.
prep.death_limit.desc: Turns auto-expedition off after this many deaths since it was turned on. No limit: never turns off.
prep.mode.desc: Explore all: searches the whole floor before going down (more loot and XP). Descend: goes down as soon as it sees the stairs >.
prep.potions.desc: Before leaving, the hero buys potions up to this amount, if there is gold. Applies on the next departure.
prep.potion_at.desc: Drinks a potion when HP drops below this value. Also drinks if the monsters' next hit could kill.
prep.retreat_hp.desc: With no potions and HP below this value, the hero gives up and flees to the exit <.
prep.auto_equip.desc: Yes: swaps to better items found in the dungeon on its own. No: swaps nothing; equip from the town chest.
prep.auto_sell.desc: Yes: on return, the bag is sold for 60% of its value (plus 20% of what was spent at the blacksmith). No: it goes to the town chest (up to 20 items; the rest is sold). Legendaries are never sold on their own: they always go to the chest and are only sold with x and a confirmation.
prep.min_rarity.desc: Minimum rarity that goes into the bag. Items the hero will equip are always picked up.
prep.any_class.desc: Also pick up items the hero's class can't use, just to sell on return.
prep.retreat_bag.desc: Returns to town when the bag is full, to sell the loot.
prep.last_floor.desc: Returns to town after finishing this floor. No limit: keeps going down.
prep.start_floor.desc: Floor where the expedition starts. Each boss defeated unlocks a shortcut. Applies on the next departure.
prep.bell.desc: Rings the terminal bell when the hero dies or defeats a boss.
prep.crt.desc: Old monitor look: green tint, scanlines and flicker. Doesn't change the game.
prep.language.desc: Language of the texts. Old log lines stay in the language they were written in.
settings.reset.desc: Erases all progress and goes back to class selection. Asks for confirmation.
town.depart.desc: Sends the hero into the dungeon now, with the settings from screen 2.
town.no_slot.desc: Nothing equipped here. Find an item in the dungeon or buy one in the shop.
town.smith.desc: Upgrades the equipped item. The bonus stays on the item for good.
town.bag.desc: More bag slots: the hero carries more loot before returning.
train.str.desc: Strength raises melee damage for the warrior, mage and cleric.
train.dex.desc: Dexterity raises speed (explores faster and acts more often in combat), accuracy, critical chance and rogue damage.
train.int.desc: Intelligence raises spell damage, mana and mana recovery (mage and cleric).
item.other_class.desc: The hero's class can't use this item.

help.page.how.text:
# Expedition
The hero leaves town, goes down floor by floor and comes back on its own. You don't control the steps: you set up the expedition on screen 2 and spend gold in town (screen 1).

# What the hero does each step
One action per step, in this order:
  1. Heals if needed: second wind, healing spell or potion.
  2. Fights the adjacent monster (the mage also attacks from range).
  3. Walks to the most important goal:
     visible monster › item it wants › stairs > (descend mode) › unexplored area › boss or stairs >.
The ▸ line above the log shows the current goal.

# Combat
One round per second; the first one plays at walking pace. Speed decides who strikes first and grants extra attacks. Heroes and monsters follow the same DEX rule:
  Miss      20% − 0.5% per DEX (at least 5%). The cleric's blessing halves it.
  Critical  0.5% per DEX (at most 25%), double damage. Adds up with item critical.
Spells never miss.

# Retreat
The hero returns to town when the bag is full, when it has no potions and low HP, when the boss looks too strong, after finishing the configured last floor, or when you press r. While retreating it flees to the stairs < without fighting; it only attacks if a monster blocks the only path.

# In town
Gold found ($ piles and slain monsters) is stored. The bag is sold for 60% of its value (plus 20% of what was spent at the blacksmith), or goes to the chest with "Sell loot on return" off. Legendaries are never sold on their own: they always go to the chest and are only sold with x and a confirmation. Blacksmith, training, shop and chest only work while the hero is in town.

# Death
Loses half the gold and all items found on the expedition. Keeps level, XP, potions and the gear it left with.

# Bosses
Every 10 floors a boss guards the stairs. It sleeps until the hero gets close. Once defeated, it drops an epic item and unlocks a shortcut to start deeper.

# Auto-expedition (a)
When on, the hero rests a few seconds in town and sets out again on its own.

# While closed
When you reopen the game, it simulates the time it was closed (up to 12 hours) and shows a summary.
help.page.attrs.text:
# Attributes
  STR  Strength: melee damage for the warrior, mage and cleric.
  DEX  Dexterity: speed (explores faster and acts more often in combat), accuracy, critical hits and rogue damage. Monsters have DEX too.
  INT  Intelligence: spell damage, mana and mana recovery (mage and cleric).
  CON  Constitution: max HP.
Every hero gains attributes on level up. Training in town adds permanent points; the description line shows the effect before you buy.

# Hero numbers
  Attack     weapon + the class damage attribute.
  Defense    armor + helmet + shield + level. Reduces damage taken.
  Speed      boots + DEX. The /s value is how many steps per second while exploring.
  Spell      damage of the best spell (mage and cleric).
  MP         mana; spells spend it and it comes back each step (faster with INT).
  Potion     heals 35% of max HP (more with the potion healing effect).

# Monsters
They get stronger every floor. Each kind has its own DEX (bat, wolf and werewolf are agile), which rises 1 every 2 floors; bosses have more.

# Item rarity
Common (white) › Magic (blue) › Rare (green) › Epic (purple) › Legendary (orange). On the same floor, a higher rarity is never weaker. Epics have 1 special effect and legendaries have 2 (life steal, critical, extra HP, extra gold, potion healing, extra XP).

# Classes
Each class only uses certain weapons and armor. Warrior and cleric use swords and maces; mage uses staves; rogue uses daggers.
